title: Count Number Frequency
statement: Given an integer array nums, return how many times each number appears.
think: What is the task asking? Count occurrences of each distinct number.
What is the key operation? Update frequency per value.
What wording signals stand out? Count, how many times, appears.
What is the brute force idea? For each number, scan the whole array again.
What is the better/optimal idea? One pass and increment dictionary counts.
What are the edge cases? Repeated numbers, negatives, one element.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(k) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I build a frequency map from number to count.
interview: I would use a dictionary because this is a frequency-counting problem. Each number maps to the number of times it appears.
ru: Это классическая задача на частоты чисел: number -> count.

nice: Do not mention O(k) extra space

gaps: Nice to have: explain distinct count vs frequency count
whyThisPattern: This is a Dictionary problem because we need value-to-count mapping.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not HashSet, because HashSet does not store occurrence counts.
Not Two Pointers, because no position movement is needed.
